messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: paging @alex (oncall) — inference-runtime-prod alert: elevated 5xx + user-visible token corruption reports for route=rvx-13b:serve (quantized variants). Spike started ~1769604800. Severity P1. See telemetry: https://observability.internal/redwood/incidents/1769605000

alex: Ack, joining. Loading dashboards now.

eng-sre-bot: Autoscaler: pods scaled 4 -> 6 due to latency. Recent deploy 1769570000 rolled q4_0 variant to 40% traffic. No config changes since.

priya: Support rachel logged 4 customer complaints citing truncated or invalid JSON outputs from model (structured outputs). Patterns look like tokenstream truncation mid-escape sequences.

tom: I see traces where batched requests interleave KV cache lookups and quantized deserialization. Example error from runtime: ```WARN runtime: deserializer: unexpected token length mismatch: expected 1280 got 512; fallback failed; returned partial buffer```

alex: Hm — could be batching + quantization serializer mismatch. Reproducing on staging with heavy concurrent small requests + prefix caching.

rachel: CS says customers alpha-delta affected intermittently. Opening high priority tickets; assigned to CS-2310/2311/2312/2313. All reported between 1769604700-1769605200.

priya: Temporary mitigation idea: reduce batch window and disable cross-request batching for this model route. Also consider disabling quantized route until we confirm serializer contract.

tom: On prod, reducing batch_window to 10ms and max_batch_size to 4: ```kubectl patch configmap infer-config -n prod --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/data/batch_window_ms","value":"10"},{"op":"replace","path":"/data/max_batch_size","value":"4"}]'``` Applying to rvx routing table.

eng-sre-bot: ConfigMap patch applied at 1769605300. New batch params picked up by runtime on all pods by 1769605440.

alex: Also toggling q4_0 route to 0% for rvx-13b via route table: ```curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' https://control.internal/redwood/routes/rvx-13b -d '{"variants":{"q4_0":0}}'```

priya: q4_0 reduced. Routing change completed 1769605600. Monitoring.

alex: After changes, 5xx dropped from 12% -> 0.9% over 10m. Token corruption reports stopped in sampling. Good sign.

priya: Customer impact window estimate: 1769604600 -> 1769605600 (~16 minutes). Rachel, can you confirm which customers saw data integrity issues vs latency?

rachel: Confirmed: alpha & beta reported malformed JSON (data integrity). gamma & delta reported elevated 5xx/timeouts. CS outreach in progress; notifying legal for any contractual flags.

tom: Root cause hypothesis: batching re-assembly path assumes serializer metadata emitted by quantized serializer (q4_0). When q4_0 was rolled, it changed compact framing (shorter headers). The batch re-assembler and KV cache rehydrate code didn't validate header length, leading to misaligned reads and truncated outputs for some batched requests. Also a race where small-batch coalescing reused buffer pool without zeroing, exposing stale bytes into streamed outputs.

alex: Confirmed local repro with toy: spawn 50 concurrent short requests against q4_0+batching, ~5% return truncated strings. PR with minimal fix to make re-assembler validate frame length and zero buffers: https://git.internal/redwood/PR-2510 (tests added).

priya: Creating follow-ups and owners:
- RW-PT-4811: Batching re-assembler: strict framing checks + error path fallback (owner: tom, due: 2026-03-23)
- RW-PT-4812: Buffer pool hygiene: zero-on-get or length-annotated slices (owner: alex, due: 2026-03-20)
- RW-PT-4813: Quantization serializer contract: enforce versioned headers and compatibility test (owner: priya, due: 2026-03-21)
- RW-PT-4814: Canary gating: add perf/serialization compatibility gate to canary pipeline (owner: priya, due: 2026-03-26)
- RW-PT-4815: Customer comms and RCA doc (owner: rachel, due: 2026-03-19)

eng-sre-bot: Created tracker tasks: https://tracker.internal/browse/RW-PT-4811..4815.

alex: Short-term safety: add runtime guard so that if re-assembly detects frame mismatch it returns a deterministic 503 to caller and drops faulty batch (so other requests don't get corrupted). Pushing hotfix to canary now.

tom: Hotfix deployed to canary 1769606600. Observing canary logs.

eng-sre-bot: Canary results: no corruption observed for 30m on canary traffic with guard. Promoting guard to prod-light rollout at 1769607200 (10% traffic) and monitor.

priya: Scheduling postmortem: 24h after incident start. Invite sent to eng-runtime, eng-oncall, eng-ml (quantization), product, cs. Calendar: https://meet.internal/redwood/pm-1769605000 at 10:00am PST. Doc: https://confluence.internal/redwood/pm/1769605000 (pre-read: logs + repro).

alex: Customer outreach: Rachel to coordinate emails and include mitigations + next steps. Please include note about potential data integrity and any recommended retry logic.

rachel: Draft sent to CS for review. Will link in incident doc.

tom: CI PR 2510 has tests; one flaky test around buffer pool on windows. Fixing.

priya: Action items summary (copied):
1) RW-PT-4811 (tom) — re-assembler checks + fallback to per-request handling (in progress).
2) RW-PT-4812 (alex) — buffer pool hygiene & tests (in progress).
3) RW-PT-4813 (priya) — serializer contract enforcement + unit tests (todo).
4) RW-PT-4814 (priya) — canary gating improvements (todo).
5) RW-PT-4815 (rachel) — customer comms & RCA doc (in progress).

alex: We'll aim to land the guard and batching fixes within 48h, then run extended canary for 72h before restoring q4_0 at low traffic.

incident-bot: Incident 1769605000 marked RESOLVED at 1769608500. Root cause: batching + quantized serializer mismatch; mitigations: reduced batching, removed q4_0 from route, runtime guard deployed.

priya: Thanks everyone for quick response. Please add any further notes to the postmortem doc before the meeting.

rachel: Noted. CS will follow up with affected customers and log resolution in customer tickets.

alex: Closing — will follow up on RW-PT-4812 and the hotfix rollout schedule.
